query.description: Your question about the codebase. Be specific about what you want to understand or explore.

context.description: Optional context about what you're trying to achieve or background information.

path.description: The path to the file to read

read_range.description: Optional [start_line, end_line] to read only specific lines

pattern.description: The search pattern to find in code. Supports GitHub search operators (AND, OR, NOT) and qualifiers (language:, path:, extension:, etc.). Max 256 characters, max 5 operators, must include at least one search term.

path.description: Optional path to limit search to specific directory or file pattern

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return (default: 30, max: 100)

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0). Must be divisible by limit.

path.description: The path to the directory to list

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 100, max: 1000)
Maximum number of results to return (default = 100).

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination

query.description: Search query to find in commit messages and author information. If empty, returns all commits.

author.description: Filter commits by author username or email

since.description: ISO 8601 date string for earliest commit date (e.g., "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z")

until.description: ISO 8601 date string for latest commit date (e.g., "2024-02-01T00:00:00Z")

path.description: Filter commits that changed specific files or directories

limit.description: Maximum number of commits to return (default: 50, max: 100)

offset.description: Number of commits to skip for pagination (default: 0). Must be divisible by limit.

base.description: The base commit SHA, branch name, or tag to compare from (e.g., "main", "v1.0.0", or commit SHA)

head.description: The head commit SHA, branch name, or tag to compare to (e.g., "feature-branch", "v2.0.0", or commit SHA)

includePatches.description: Include unified diff patches per file (token heavy, truncated to ~4k characters per file). Default false.

pattern.description: Optional pattern to match in repository names

organization.description: Optional organization name to filter repositories

language.description: Optional programming language to filter repositories

limit.description: Maximum number of repositories to return (default: 30, max: 100)

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0). Must be divisible by limit.
